stemMd: A tap fills a tank in 6 hours, while a drain empties a full tank in 9 hours. Both operate at constant rates. Starting empty, how long will filling take with both open?
explanationMd: The filling rate is 1/6 tank per hour and draining rate 1/9. Net rate is 1/6 − 1/9 = 1/18 tank per hour, so a full tank takes 18 hours. A slower result than six hours is consistent with simultaneous drainage.

distractorRationale.d: Subtracting completion times does not combine rates.
distractorRationale.c: Averaging completion times is not a net-rate calculation.
distractorRationale.a: Adding completion times does not give the combined time.
distractorRationale.e: This multiplies the times without taking the rate difference numerator into account.
